remaining: File was already at the promoted path when I started (staging no longer had a copy); transcription.verifiedBy/verifiedAt and paper.status=review were already set to the required values, so no edits were needed.

Per-part point values are not printed in the problem sheet (only 'Всяка задача се оценява максимално с 10 точки.'); they are summed from the [… т.] brackets in the solutions. Sums are exactly 10/10/10 = 30 and this is documented in transcription.notes.

Two minor Bulgarian grammar slips of the source are preserved verbatim but not itemised in transcription.notes: 'Тъй като тока' (зад. 1 в), solutions p.1) and 'Съгласно с първия принцип' (зад. 2 а), solutions p.3). Content is faithful; only the notes list is incomplete.
